lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੋ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadho man kaa maan tiaagau ||
lines.translation: Holy Saadhus: forsake the pride of your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਕੀ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਾਗਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh sa(n)gat durajan kee taa te ahinis bhaagau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger and the company of evil people - run away from them, day and night. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੋਨੋ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh dukh dono sam kar jaanai aur maan apamaanaa ||
lines.translation: One who knows that pain and pleasure are both the same, and honor and dishonor as well,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਗਿ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: harakh sog te rahai ateetaa tin jag tat pachhaanaa ||1||
lines.translation: who remains detached from joy and sorrow, realizes the true essence in the world. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਖੋਜੈ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: usatat ni(n)daa dooo tiaagai khojai pad nirabaanaa ||
lines.translation: Renounce both praise and blame; seek instead the state of Nirvaanaa.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਠਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ihu khel kathan hai kinahoo(n) guramukh jaanaa ||2||1||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, this is such a difficult game; only a few Gurmukhs understand it! ||2||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੋ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਬਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadho rachanaa raam banaaee ||
lines.translation: Holy Saadhus: the Lord fashioned the creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਇਕ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਲਖਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik binasai ik asathir maanai acharaj lakhio na jaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One person passes away, and another thinks that he will live forever - this is a wonder beyond understanding! ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮੋਹ ਬਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh moh bas praanee har moorat bisaraaee ||
lines.translation: The mortal beings are held in the power of sexual desire, anger and emotional attachment; they have forgotten the Lord, the Immortal Form.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਰੈਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothaa tan saachaa kar maanio jiu supanaa rainaaee ||1||
lines.translation: The body is false, but they believe it to be true; it is like a dream in the night. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਦਰ ਕੀ ਛਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo deesai so sagal binaasai jiu baadar kee chhaaee ||
lines.translation: Whatever is seen, shall all pass away, like the shadow of a cloud.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਰਹਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak jag jaanio mithiaa rahio raam saranaaee ||2||2||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, one who knows the world to be unreal, dwells in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: praanee kau har jas man nahee aavai ||
lines.translation: The Praise of the Lord does not come to dwell in the minds of the mortal beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਮਗਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis magan rahai maaiaa mai kahu kaise gun gaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Day and night, they remain engrossed in Maya. Tell me, how can they sing God's Glories? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਤ ਮੀਤ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: poot meet maaiaa mamataa siu ih bidh aap ba(n)dhaavai ||
lines.translation: In this way, they bind themselves to children, friends, Maya and possessiveness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਿਉ ਝੂਠੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਗ ਦੇਖਿ ਤਾਸਿ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mrig trisanaa jiu jhootho ihu jag dekh taas uth dhaavai ||1||
lines.translation: Like the deer's delusion, this world is false; and yet, beholding it, they chase after it. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਾ ਕਾਰਨੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੂੜ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhugat mukat kaa kaaran suaamee mooR taahi bisaraavai ||
lines.translation: Our Lord and Master is the source of pleasures and liberation; and yet, the fool forgets Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਨ ਮੈ ਕੋਊ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kotan mai kooo bhajan raam ko paavai ||2||3||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, among millions, there is scarcely anyone who attains the Lord's meditation. ||2||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadho ihu man gahio na jaaee ||
lines.translation: Holy Saadhus: this mind cannot be restrained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਯਾ ਤੇ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)chal trisanaa sa(n)g basat hai yaa te thir na rahaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Fickle desires dwell with it, and so it cannot remain steady. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਠਨ ਕਰੋਧ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਕੇ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਿਹ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਸਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kathan karodh ghat hee ke bheetar jih sudh sabh bisaraaee ||
lines.translation: The heart is filled with anger and violence, which cause all sense to be forgotten.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ratan giaan sabh ko hir leenaa taa siu kachh na basaaee ||1||
lines.translation: The jewel of spiritual wisdom has been taken away from everyone; nothing can withstand it. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਰੇ ਗੁਨੀ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jogee jatan karat sabh haare gunee rahe gun gaaee ||
lines.translation: The Yogis have tried everything and failed; the virtuous have grown weary of singing God's Glories.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਤਉ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੨॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har bhae daiaalaa tau sabh bidh ban aaee ||2||4||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, when the Lord becomes merciful, then every effort is successful. ||2||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੋ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadho gobi(n)d ke gun gaavau ||
lines.translation: Holy Saadhus: sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕਾਹਿ ਗਵਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanas janam amolak paaio birathaa kaahi gavaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You have obtained the priceless jewel of this human life; why are you uselessly wasting it? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਆਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit puneet deen ba(n)dh har saran taahi tum aavau ||
lines.translation: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Friend of the poor. Come, and enter the Lord's Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਜ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤੁਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਰਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gaj ko traas mitio jih simarat tum kaahe bisaraavau ||1||
lines.translation: Remembering Him, the elephant's fear was removed; so why do you forget Him? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੁਨਿ ਭਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj abhimaan moh maaiaa phun bhajan raam chit laavau ||
lines.translation: Renounce your egotistical pride and your emotional attachment to Maya; focus your consciousness on the Lord's meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 9 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਮਾਈ ਭੂਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooo maaee bhoolio man samajhaavai ||
lines.translation: O mother, if only someone would instruct my wayward mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪੰਥ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kahat mukat pa(n)th ihu guramukh hoi tum paavau ||2||5||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, this is the path to liberation. Become Gurmukh, and attain it. ||2||5||
